## 1. Introduction and Scope Boundary

This file is rendered for deterministic curation review and graph ingestion. Runtime/client cards are out of scope for reusable domain packs.

Locked full-spectrum validation applies: structural checks, claim consistency, curation quality, SQL blueprint checks, deterministic field-reference edge coverage, and no warnings.

          before netting values.

    source_capture:
      intent: reconciliation
      natural_language_patterns:
      - 7.2 Returns to OMS to Settlement Full Chain
      sql_ref: sql.jiomart.marketplace.7_2_returns_oms_settlement_full_chain
      sql_template: "SELECT\n  r.order_id,\n  r.return_type,\n  CAST(r.refund_amount AS DOUBLE) AS refund_issued,\n\
        \  o.charged_amount AS original_sale,\n  SUM(s.settled_amount) AS settlement_net\nFROM zs_observe.jiomart_returns\
        \ r\nLEFT JOIN zs_observe.jiomart_oms o ON r.order_id = o.order_id AND o.is_active = true\nLEFT JOIN zs_observe.jiomart_settlement\
        \ s ON r.order_id = s.order_id AND s.is_active = true\nWHERE r.is_active = true AND r.return_type IS NOT\
        \ NULL\nGROUP BY r.order_id, r.return_type, r.refund_amount, o.charged_amount;"
      source_tables:
      - table.zs_observe.jiomart_oms
      - table.zs_observe.jiomart_returns
      - table.zs_observe.jiomart_settlement
      required_filters: Use filters exactly as written in SQL plus applicable mandatory query filters.
      output_contract_id: output_contract.jiomart.return_reconciliation
      reconciliation_profile_id: reconciliation_profile.jiomart.oms_settlement_3way

    - required JioMart filters, casts, table grain, and linked query/metric logic

      grain_assertion: Output follows query_output_grain and must not be joined to lower-grain rows without pre-aggregation.

    source_capture:

      natural_language_patterns:
      - 7.4 TCS Reconciliation
      sql_ref: sql.jiomart.marketplace.7_4_tcs_reconciliation
      sql_template: 'SELECT ''OMS TCS'' AS source, SUM(total_tcs_amount) AS amount

        FROM zs_observe.jiomart_oms WHERE is_active = true AND transaction_type = ''forward''

        UNION ALL

        SELECT ''Settlement BaseTcs (Forward)'', SUM(settled_amount)

        FROM zs_observe.jiomart_settlement

        WHERE is_active = true AND accountable_type = ''BaseTcs'' AND transaction_type = ''forward''

        UNION ALL

        SELECT ''Settlement BaseTcs (Return Reversal)'', SUM(settled_amount)

        FROM zs_observe.jiomart_settlement

        WHERE is_active = true AND accountable_type = ''BaseTcs'' AND transaction_type = ''reverse'';'
      source_tables:

      - table.zs_observe.jiomart_settlement

        \ AS oms_tds,\n  SUM(CASE WHEN s.accountable_type = 'Receivable' THEN s.settled_amount ELSE 0 END) AS settled_receivable,\n\
        \  SUM(CASE WHEN s.accountable_type = 'BaseTcs' THEN s.settled_amount ELSE 0 END) AS settled_tcs,\n  SUM(CASE\
        \ WHEN s.accountable_type = 'Tds' THEN s.settled_amount ELSE 0 END) AS settled_tds,\n  CASE WHEN SUM(s.settled_amount)\
        \ IS NULL THEN 'Not in Settlement' ELSE 'Matched' END AS status\nFROM zs_observe.jiomart_oms o\nLEFT JOIN\
        \ zs_observe.jiomart_settlement s\n  ON o.order_id = s.order_id\n  AND s.is_active = true\n  AND s.event\
        \ IS NOT NULL\nWHERE o.is_active = true\n  AND o.transaction_type = 'forward'\n  AND o.order_status = 'delivered'\n\

        \ AS tcs_impact,\n  SUM(CASE WHEN accountable_type = 'Tds' THEN settled_amount ELSE 0 END) AS tds_impact,\n\
        \  SUM(settled_amount) AS net_settled\nFROM zs_observe.jiomart_settlement\nWHERE is_active = true AND event\
        \ IS NOT NULL\nGROUP BY order_id\nORDER BY net_settled DESC\nLIMIT 20;"
      source_tables:
      - table.zs_observe.jiomart_settlement
      required_filters: Use filters exactly as written in SQL plus applicable mandatory query filters.
      output_contract_id: output_contract.jiomart.metric_summary
      primary_metric_id: metric.jiomart.net_settlement_per_order
    qualifying_filters:
    - required JioMart filters, casts, table grain, and linked query/metric logic
